description: JHYY (机会翼游) — statically-typed language + bootstrapping compiler for Windows
pre_install: // Burn bundle is a per-machine MSI wrapper; admin elevation required.
// Scoop is per-user by default — the bundled MSI's per-machine install
// writes to C:\Program Files\JHYY\ and HKLM PATH. Run elevated:
// Or accept the UAC prompt during install.
post_install: // After Burn bundle installs jhyy.exe to C:\Program Files\JHYY\bin\,
// verify it is reachable: 'where jhyy' should list it under Program Files.
// Note: jhyy.exe requires MSYS2 + ucrt64 GCC for compile/link (qbe+as+ld).
// See https://www.msys2.org/ — the installer Welcome page also prompts.

script: // Burn bundle uninstall — same ProductCode as MSI.
// Or: Settings -> Apps -> JHYY Compiler -> Uninstall.
